definitions.explanation: An orbit shaped like a circle, in which a body keeps a roughly constant distance from the object it orbits.

examples.japanese: {衛星|えいせい}が{円軌道|えんきどう}を{描|えが}く。
examples.english: The satellite traces a circular orbit.

examples.japanese: {人工衛星|じんこうえいせい}を{円軌道|えんきどう}に{乗|の}せる。
examples.english: To put an artificial satellite into a circular orbit.

examples.japanese: この{惑星|わくせい}はほぼ{円軌道|えんきどう}で{太陽|たいよう}の{周|まわ}りを{回|まわ}っている。
examples.english: This planet moves around the sun in a nearly circular orbit.

notes:
USAGE: {円軌道|えんきどう} is a circular orbit, contrasted with an elliptical one. It combines {円|えん} (circle) with {軌道|きどう} (orbit).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {円軌道|えんきどう}を{描|えが}く: to trace a circular orbit
- {円軌道|えんきどう}に{乗|の}せる: to place into a circular orbit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {楕円軌道|だえんきどう}: elliptical orbit — the distance varies
- {静止軌道|せいしきどう}: geostationary orbit
